dependencies.reason: Source diagnoses, native lifecycle boundaries and whole-function inventory are inputs to this contract.

execution.rule: Anchor each slash-separated selector component separately. Require run and pass for exact full subtest name and package pass, never exit zero alone. Future names are obligations, not implemented evidence.
execution.scratch: After implementing F2, build shipped CLI and repeat operator authorization -> scoped queue -> close/reopen SQLite in a scratch git project. Record actual command argv, exit codes, decision-ref, branch/candidate hash, A/Settings rows and original receipt byte comparison.
execution.negative_controls: Run each named mutation against its mapped tests with Go source overlays, verify intended assertion fails, restore source hashes, then rerun positive tests. Compile errors, skips and unrelated failures are not proof.
